rules.rule_en: One-word substitution is a concept where a single word replaces a phrase or sentence to make communication more concise and clear.
Affixes are the building blocks of English. A prefix is a small unit placed at the beginning of a word to modify or qualify its meaning.
A suffix is a small unit placed at the end of a word to form a derivative.
An infix is placed within a word (rare in English).
Acronym is a type of abbreviation where a new word is formed from the first letters of a series of words; it is pronounced as a separate word.
Compound words are formed when two or more words are put together to form a new word with a new meaning.
